clips.title: The story
paras: Grommash Hellscream was the legendary chieftain of the Warsong clan, a close brother-in-arms to Warchief Thrall, and the first orc to drink the blood of Mannoroth. Though his thirst for battle once bound his people to the Burning Legion, he redeemed the orcish race by slaying the demon lord in Ashenvale at the cost of his own life.

Before the Dark Portal ever bridged worlds, Grom Hellscream led the Warsong clan with unyielding ferocity, distinguished by his pitch-black tattooed jaw and the deadly sweep of his two-handed axe, Gorehowl. When Gul'dan and the Shadow Council offered the chalice of demonic strength on Draenor, Grom was the first chieftain to drink the blood of the pit lord Mannoroth. That fateful draught doomed the orcish race to demonic subservience and a burning bloodlust. Yet unlike many chieftains who perished or succumbed entirely, Grom possessed an iron will that kept his fierce spirit intact, surviving the horrors of the old Horde while harboring an unspoken ache for what his people had surrendered.
